questionEn: Elements of the same group have similar properties. Why?
questionUz: Xuddi shu guruhning elementlari o'xshash xususiyatlarga ega. Nega?
choicesEn: They have the same number of electrons in the outer level
They have the same number of neutrons
choicesUz: Ularning tashqi sathida bir xil miqdordagi elektronlar mavjud
Ularda bir xil miqdordagi neytronlar mavjud
